title: bot-limits.v1
description: An account's resolved bot limits: the ONE carrier of them from the identity domain to the meetings domain, as the `bot_limits` field of admin-api's internal `GET /internal/users/{id}/bot-context` answer. Identity resolves it (it owns the tables); meetings enforces it (meeting-api limits.py, the one parser). A key identity has no value for is absent and meetings applies its built-in default; a value meetings cannot read as a limit is ignored there the same way. A reader that does not know `version` refuses the whole object.

Rate.description: A token bucket: `burst` events at once, refilled at `per_minute`.

Limit.description: Any limit value: a count or a duration in seconds (a non-negative number), or a rate. A limit added later is a new key with one of these shapes, not a new carrier.

max_concurrent_bots.description: Bots at once, queued ones counted: the account's `users.max_concurrent_bots` column (0 for the instance admin account, which launches no bot). 0 means no bot may start; never 'no limit'.

bot_start_rate.description: Bot starts, every path (built-in 10 at once, 0.5 a minute).

seat_cooldown_s.description: How long a user-stopped ad-hoc bot keeps its seat (built-in 60).

queue_wait_s.description: How long a queued bot waits for a seat once late (built-in 1800).

max_scheduled_bots.description: Booked bots overlapping one slot (built-in 5; enforced at booking).

booking_rate.description: Planned rows an account creates (built-in 200 at once, 10 an hour; enforced at booking).

Resolution.description: A resolution vector: what identity holds for one account, and the BotLimits it must answer. `user_data` is the account's `users.data` (its `bot_limits` override and its `subscription_tier`); `platform` is the `platform_settings` row `bot_limits` (`default`, and `plans` keyed by subscription tier). Per key: the account's override, else its plan's, else the platform default.
